quotes.description: Data figures this line reads aloud, as dotted paths into towers.json or enemies.json — e.g. shield-wall.draw_mw, restorer.effect.value, reach-sapper.drains_mw. The `dialog figures` gate check resolves each and asserts the live value is spoken in `text`. DECLARED rather than parsed, because neither parsing strategy works: 'forty of those ninety-four' carries no unit word so a regex over 'N megawatts' misses it, and a blanket rule that every spoken number be a live figure fails on 'four lanes' and on anchor-08's deliberately unexplained nine megawatts. The writer names the dependency; the check does the arithmetic.
